PLAN "Perimenopause Strength, Cooling, Cardio, Hot Yoga & Nutrition Programme (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build and maintain strength during perimenopause"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Support bone health and manage perimenopausal symptoms"
  GOAL secondary cardio:
    name "Maintain aerobic fitness safely"
  GOAL secondary flexibility:
    name "Improve flexibility with yoga"
  GOAL secondary testing:
    name "Assess 1RM strength at end of programme"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      description "3 full-body strength sessions, 2 hot yoga, 2 cardio, 1 accessory/mobility per week. Moderate intensity, focus on technique, adaptation, and cooling strategies."
  PHASE "Phase 2: Progressive Overload & Intensity" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      description "3 full-body strength sessions with increased intensity (RPE 8–9), 2 hot yoga, 2 cardio, 1 accessory/mobility per week. Emphasis on strength gains, aerobic fitness, and flexibility. Cooling and hydration prioritized."
  PHASE "Phase 3: Strength & Power Integration + 1RM Testing" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      description "3 full-body strength/power sessions, 2 hot yoga, 2 cardio, 1 accessory/mobility per week. Final week includes 1RM testing for squat, bench_press, deadlift, overhead_press. All sessions include structured cooling and hydration."

NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    description "Aim for maintenance calories or slight surplus if muscle gain is desired. Adjust based on cycle phase, symptoms, and training load."
  PROTEIN:
    description "1.6–2.0g/kg bodyweight daily. Prioritize high-quality sources (lean meats, fish, eggs, dairy, legumes, tofu, tempeh)."
  CALCIUM:
    description "1200mg daily. Include dairy (milk, yogurt, cheese), fortified plant milks, leafy greens, tofu, almonds, sardines with bones."
  VITAMIN D:
    description "800–2000 IU daily from food and/or supplementation. Include fatty fish, fortified foods, and safe sun exposure."
  MAGNESIUM:
    description "320–400mg daily. Include nuts, seeds, whole grains, leafy greens, legumes."
  OMEGA-3:
    description "2–3 servings fatty fish/week or supplement with 1–2g EPA/DHA daily."
  IRON:
    description "Ensure adequate intake, especially if cycles are heavy. Include lean red meat, poultry, fish, lentils, beans, spinach. Pair with vitamin C-rich foods."
  PHYTOESTROGENS:
    description "Include moderate amounts of soy foods (tofu, tempeh, edamame), flaxseed, and legumes to support symptom management."
  HYDRATION:
    description "2.5–3L water daily. Increase intake during hot flashes or heavy sweating. Use cool fluids and avoid excess caffeine/alcohol."
  COOLING_STRATEGIES:
    description "Emphasize cold foods (salads, yogurt, smoothies), avoid spicy foods if they trigger symptoms, and use smaller, frequent meals if appetite fluctuates."
  ALCOHOL:
    description "Limit to <7 drinks/week. Avoid excess to support bone health and symptom management."
  CAFFEINE:
    description "Limit to <300mg/day. Monitor for symptom triggers."
  SUPPLEMENTATION:
    description "Consider calcium, vitamin D, and magnesium supplements if dietary intake is insufficient. Consult with healthcare provider before starting new supplements."
  NOTES:
    description "Prioritize nutrient-dense, minimally processed foods. Monitor symptoms and adjust intake as needed. Consider working with a registered dietitian for personalized support."

PLAN "Perimenopause Strength, Cooling, Cardio, Hot Yoga & Nutrition Programme (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build and maintain strength during perimenopause"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Support bone health and manage perimenopausal symptoms"
  GOAL secondary cardio:
    name "Maintain aerobic fitness safely"
  GOAL secondary flexibility:
    name "Improve flexibility with yoga"
  GOAL secondary testing:
    name "Assess 1RM strength at end of programme"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      description "3 full-body strength sessions, 2 hot yoga, 2 cardio, 1 accessory/mobility per week. Moderate intensity, focus on technique, adaptation, and cooling strategies."
  PHASE "Phase 2: Progressive Overload & Intensity" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      description "3 full-body strength sessions with increased intensity (RPE 8–9), 2 hot yoga, 2 cardio, 1 accessory/mobility per week. Emphasis on strength gains, aerobic fitness, and flexibility. Cooling and hydration prioritized."
  PHASE "Phase 3: Strength & Power Integration + 1RM Testing" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      description "3 full-body strength/power sessions, 2 hot yoga, 2 cardio, 1 accessory/mobility per week. Final week includes 1RM testing for squat, bench_press, deadlift, overhead_press. All sessions include structured cooling and hydration."

NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    description "Aim for maintenance calories or slight surplus if muscle gain is desired. Adjust based on cycle phase, symptoms, and training load."
  PROTEIN:
    description "1.6–2.0g/kg bodyweight daily. Prioritize high-quality sources (lean meats, fish, eggs, dairy, legumes, tofu, tempeh)."
  CALCIUM:
    description "1200mg daily. Include dairy (milk, yogurt, cheese), fortified plant milks, leafy greens, tofu, almonds, sardines with bones."
  VITAMIN D:
    description "800–2000 IU daily from food and/or supplementation. Include fatty fish, fortified foods, and safe sun exposure."
  MAGNESIUM:
    description "320–400mg daily. Include nuts, seeds, whole grains, leafy greens, legumes."
  OMEGA-3:
    description "2–3 servings fatty fish/week or supplement with 1–2g EPA/DHA daily."
  IRON:
    description "Ensure adequate intake, especially if cycles are heavy. Include lean red meat, poultry, fish, lentils, beans, spinach. Pair with vitamin C-rich foods."
  PHYTOESTROGENS:
    description "Include moderate amounts of soy foods (tofu, tempeh, edamame), flaxseed, and legumes to support symptom management."
  HYDRATION:
    description "2.5–3L water daily. Increase intake during hot flashes or heavy sweating. Use cool fluids and avoid excess caffeine/alcohol."
  COOLING_STRATEGIES:
    description "Emphasize cold foods (salads, yogurt, smoothies), avoid spicy foods if they trigger symptoms, and use smaller, frequent meals if appetite fluctuates."
  ALCOHOL:
    description "Limit to <7 drinks/week. Avoid excess to support bone health and symptom management."
  CAFFEINE:
    description "Limit to <300mg/day. Monitor for symptom triggers."
  SUPPLEMENTATION:
    description "Consider calcium, vitamin D, and magnesium supplements if dietary intake is insufficient. Consult with healthcare provider before starting new supplements."
  NOTES:
    description "Prioritize nutrient-dense, minimally processed foods. Monitor symptoms and adjust intake as needed. Consider working with a registered dietitian for personalized support."
